_about: Other on-screen UI text. howto = labels for the control pictures, based on art/ui/howto_labels.json (digits removed: no numbers on screen). '|' in ja labels = the only places a label may wrap (removed on screen), same as subtitles. test = test-build only. credit = voice credit on the start screen (both languages). artCredit = inn picture credit (Created with Grok), a second line on the start screen, not over the title. p04: titleFull = full title with subtitle (document title, credits). subtitle = the line under the title on the start screen. genre/headphones/menu/difficulty = opening + difficulty select (planner: docs/opening_difficulty_v0.md). credits = the Credits screen (no digits).
